The 'records_written' key above is deliberately NOT this sum: 1898 is the frozen v1 historical publish figure pinned as v1_manifest_records_written by scripts/audit_pre_upgrade.py and copied into reports/pre_upgrade_audit.json, reports/rights_history_exposure.json and reports/rights_inventory.json. It counts pointers, not distinct records: a finding and its exploit/patch rows share an id, and each split row points back at a jsonl row. The two numbers are kept separate so the historical pin cannot drift while the breakdown stays live.
